trans-unit.source:
Although it is not a requirement for IFC objects to have fully clean and solid geometry (and you will more than often find IFC files with bad geometry out there, oh boy if you find!), it is of course better if they do. You will reduce chances of problems with other applications, and after all, in real life, all objects have solid shapes.

FreeCAD has a lot of tools to check for geometry quality, and most parametric objects, including BIM objects, will usually warn you if their geometry becomes unclean or not solid at some point. This test makes sure everything is OK.
trans-unit.target:
IFC-objekt behöver inte ha helt ren och solid geometri. Det är ändå bättre om de har det. Du minskar risken för problem med andra program. Alla objekt har trots allt solida former i verkligheten.

FreeCAD innehåller många verktyg för att kontrollera geometrikvaliteten. De flesta parametriska objekt, inklusive BIM-objekt, varnar vanligtvis om geometrin blir oren eller osolid. Testet kontrollerar att allt är i ordning.
